`summary.csv` is written to `/tmp/psz-work/r1a/t2_expenses/full/1/summary.csv` with six rows, one per month and category.

I did the arithmetic by hand and did not run a script to check it.

Assumptions:
- Duplicates E02 and E09 were counted once each.
- USD amounts were converted at 0.92 and rounded only in the final totals. Software 2026-11 is 15.99 × 0.92 = 14.7108, which rounds to 14.71.
- E12 is dated 2026-11-27, after today (2026-11-25). I included it because the rules don't exclude future dates. If it shouldn't count yet, the 2026-11 reizen total drops from 179.28 to 120.40.
